settings.subtitle: Mueller Commons is a converted aircraft hangar ten minutes from downtown, with a main stage, two breakout halls, a workshop lab and a courtyard for the evening events.

settings.name: Mueller Commons
settings.body: The venue is fully step-free, with quiet rooms on both floors, a parents' room, gender-neutral restrooms and live captioning on every stage.

cards.title: Flying in
cards.text: Austin–Bergstrom (AUS) has direct flights from 90+ cities. Rideshare to the venue takes about 20 minutes.

cards.title: Hotel block
cards.text: Discounted rooms at two hotels within a ten-minute walk. Book by March 12, 2027 for the conference rate.

cards.title: Transit
cards.text: CapMetro route 20 stops outside. We run a free shuttle loop from downtown each morning and evening.

cards.title: Bikes & scooters
cards.text: Secure bike parking at the north entrance and a scooter corral on Hangar Lane.

cards.title: Food
cards.text: Breakfast and lunch are included, with vegetarian, vegan, halal and gluten-free options marked on every station.

cards.title: Evenings
cards.text: Courtyard social on Day 1, a live music night on Day 2 (it is Austin), and a quiet closing dinner on Day 3.
